intro: Mountaineer Stormpike's Task is a brief Alliance courier dispatch in Loch Modan. Mountaineer Kadrell directs roving adventurers to the northern watchtower, where Mountaineer Stormpike requires a reliable runner for an assignment beyond the valley. It serves as an introduction to a longer errand that reaches into neighboring lands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I hear Mountaineer Stormpike is looking for a runner. Someone to do a little traveling for him. How about it? Are you the traveler for the job?
If so, then you'll find Stormpike at the top of the northern guard tower.

clips.title: Completion
paras: That's right. I have a task that I can't do while I'm guarding. In fact, it'll take you far from Loch Modan.
